content.text: This matches the preferred position precisely.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand. Failure to send the reminder extends Customer's opt-out deadline until thirty days after the reminder is received.
input.rationale: § 8.2 provides automatic renewal for successive twelve-month (not multi-year) terms that we may exit on only thirty days' written notice, plus a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal and an extension of our opt-out deadline if the reminder is missed — all four elements of the preferred position. § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, which is the preferred cap or better. The reminder mechanic and uplift cap run in our favour, so no redline is warranted.
